<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 3.1 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>HPS NET LEASE INCOME REIT </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CERTIFICATE OF TRUST </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">THIS
IS TO CERTIFY THAT: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><U>FIRST:</U> The undersigned trustee does hereby form a statutory trust pursuant to the Maryland
Statutory Trust Act. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><U>SECOND:</U> The name of the statutory trust (the &#8220;Trust&#8221;) is: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">HPS Net Lease Income REIT </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><U>THIRD:</U> The address of the Trust&#8217;s principal office in the State of Maryland is c/o The Corporation Trust
Incorporated, 2405 York Road, Suite 201, Lutherville-Timonium, Maryland 21093-2264. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><U>FOURTH:</U> The name and business
address of the Trust&#8217;s resident agent are The Corporation Trust Incorporated, 2405 York Road, Suite 201, Lutherville-Timonium, Maryland 21093-2264. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><U>FIFTH:</U> Pursuant to <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Section&nbsp;12-501(d)</FONT> of the Maryland Statutory Trust Act,
the assets of each series or class of beneficial interest in the Trust are subject to limitations on liability as set forth in the governing instrument of the Trust. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify"><U>SIXTH:</U> The undersigned trustee of the Trust acknowledges under the penalties of perjury, that to the best of his or her
knowledge and belief, the facts stated herein are true. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">[SIGNATURE PAGE FOLLOWS] </P>
